landing_headline: Sittuyin on a hand-rubbed teak board
landing_description: Play authentic Myanmar Sittuyin on an uncheckered 8x8 teak board with inlaid sit ke myin promotion diagonals, hidden simultaneous setup, and carved Burmese wooden pieces.
landing_pieces_subheading: Vermilion lacquer & burnished gold Red pieces against smoked ebony & antique ivory Black pieces
landing_feature_setup_body: Arrange your 8 officers privately with drag, swap, random setup, or 5 classic Myanmar opening formations.
landing_feature_sitkemyin_body: When you have no General on the board, promote an eligible pawn in place or 1 square diagonally into a Sit ke.
landing_feature_replay_body: Study every ply in Myanmar or English notation and paste any Sittuyin FEN + UCI sequence to scrub move by move.
copied_uci_toast: Copied UCI move list to clipboard
setup_subtitle: Place all 8 officers inside your zone. Chariots (Rooks) must be placed on the back rank.
setup_locked_notice: Formation locked. Click Unlock if you want to adjust pieces.
setup_drag_hint: Tap or drag officers onto glowing squares. Drag off-board or double-tap to remove.
handoff_description: {fromSide} has locked in their formation. Hand the device to {toSide} before revealing the board.
promote_description: Choose whether to promote in place or step 1 square diagonally.
history_empty: No moves played yet. Complete setup to begin the match.
scrubber_readonly_banner: Inspecting an earlier ply. Return to live to play moves.
replay_page_subtitle: Paste an initial Sittuyin FEN and UCI moves to inspect every ply.
prefs_description: Saved locally in this browser for your table.
prefs_script_overlay: Burmese script badges on pieces (မ, စ, ရ, ဆ, မြ, န)
prefs_sit_ke_myin: Highlight sit ke myin promotion diagonals
err_INVALID_PHASE: That action is not allowed in the current match phase.
err_INVALID_SETUP_MODE: This setup action requires hidden simultaneous setup mode.
err_SIDE_ALREADY_LOCKED: Your formation is locked. Unlock first to make changes.
err_SQUARE_OCCUPIED: That square already has an officer placed on it.
err_SQUARE_EMPTY: There is no drafted officer on that square.
err_ROOK_MUST_BE_BACK_RANK: Chariots (Rooks) must be placed on your back rank.
err_OUTSIDE_SETUP_ZONE: That square is outside your legal setup zone.
err_PIECE_NOT_IN_HAND: No remaining officers of that type in your tray.
err_SETUP_INCOMPLETE: Place all 8 officers before locking your formation.
err_WRONG_TURN: It is not that side's turn to move.
err_PROMOTION_NOT_ALLOWED: General promotion is not allowed here.
err_ILLEGAL_STALEMATE: Delivering stalemate is illegal under Myanmar Sittuyin rules.
err_INVALID_PIECE_COUNT: Piece counts exceed traditional Sittuyin limits.
err_OPPONENT_IN_CHECK: Invalid position: the opponent King cannot start in check.
err_REPLAY_MOVE_FAILED: A move in the replay sequence could not be applied.
